chooseLetter.label: Choose the Right Letter
chooseLetter.description: Fill in the missing letter – tap or type

accents.label: Put Missing Accents
accents.description: Add háčky (ˇ) and čárky (´) — or leave as-is

confusedWords.label: Commonly Confused Words
confusedWords.description: Choose between easily confused Czech words (long vs short vowels, similar sounds)

A1.question: to wash
A1.explanation: 'mýt' (long ý) = to wash; 'mít' (long í) = to have

A1.question: to have
A1.explanation: 'mít' (long í) = to have; 'mýt' (long ý) = to wash

A1.question: he/she knows
A1.explanation: 'ví' (long í) = knows; 'vi' is not a Czech word

A1.question: he was
A1.explanation: 'byl' = he was (from být); 'bil' = he hit (from bít)

A1.question: he hit
A1.explanation: 'bil' = he hit (from bít); 'byl' = he was (from být)

A1.question: smoke
A1.explanation: 'dým' (long ý) = smoke; the long vowel is essential

A1.question: cheese
A1.explanation: 'sýr' (long ý) = cheese; 'sir' is not a Czech word

A1.question: rice
A1.explanation: 'rýže' (long ý + ž) = rice; 'říže' is not a word

A1.question: to bake
A1.explanation: 'péct' (long é) = to bake; the vowel must be long

A1.question: 'To live' (be alive) is:
A1.explanation: 'žít' with ž = to live; ž (háček) is essential here

A1.question: to fly
A1.explanation: 'létat' (long é) = to fly; the vowel length is essential

A2.question: already
A2.explanation: 'už' with ž = already; ž and š are different sounds

A2.question: 'Pen' (writing tool) is:
A2.explanation: 'pero' (short e) = pen/feather; 'péro' (long é) = spring

A2.question: 'Spring' (mechanical) is:
A2.explanation: 'péro' (long é) = spring; 'pero' (short e) = pen

A2.question: advice / council
A2.explanation: 'rada' = advice/council; 'řada' = row/series

A2.question: row / series
A2.explanation: 'řada' (with ř) = row/series; 'rada' = advice

A2.question: 'On top' / 'upstairs' is:
A2.explanation: 'nahoře' – the ř and ě are both essential

A2.question: to search for
A2.explanation: 'hledat' – short e; no long vowel in this verb

A2.question: ice
A2.explanation: 'led' – standard Czech spelling; short e

A2.question: barrel / cask
A2.explanation: 'sud' (short u) = barrel; Czech doesn't use ú here

A2.question: horse
A2.explanation: 'kůň' (with ů) = horse; ů marks long u inside a word

A2.question: house
A2.explanation: 'dům' (with ů) = house; ů is required in the middle

A2.question: salt
A2.explanation: 'sůl' (with ů) = salt; long vowel is essential

A2.question: February
A2.explanation: 'únor' (with ú) = February; ú at word start

A2.question: harm / damage
A2.explanation: 'újma' (with ú) = harm; ú required at word start

A2.question: soup
A2.explanation: 'polévka' is standard Czech; 'polívka' is colloquial (obecná čeština).

A2.question: small
A2.explanation: 'malý' is standard; 'malej' is colloquial Bohemian speech.

A2.question: to be
A2.explanation: 'být' is standard Czech; 'bejt' is colloquial.

A2.question: to wash (e.g. hair)
A2.explanation: 'mýt' = to wash; 'mít' = to have. Only the vowel differs.

A2.question: 'Villa' (a house) is:
A2.explanation: 'vila' (short i) = villa; 'víla' (long í) = fairy.

A2.question: 'To be' vs 'to beat':
A2.explanation: 'být' = to be; 'bít' = to beat/hit.

A2.question: house
A2.explanation: 'dům' is neutral/standard; 'barák' is colloquial.

A2.question: 'Advice / council' (not 'glad') is:
A2.explanation: 'rada' = advice or council; 'ráda' = glad/gladly (feminine).

B1.question: to travel
B1.explanation: 'cestovat' – no háček on e; ě doesn't follow c here

B1.question: chair
B1.explanation: 'židle' (short i) = chair; no long vowel

B1.question: duty / obligation
B1.explanation: 'povinnost' – doubled nn is correct in this noun

B1.question: to pour
B1.explanation: 'lít' (soft í) = to pour; hard ý would be wrong

B1.question: to drive / steer
B1.explanation: 'řídit' – ř (with háček) is essential here

B1.question: 'Friend' (male) is:
B1.explanation: 'přítel' – long í in the prefix pří- is required

B1.question: to believe
B1.explanation: 'věřit' – the ě is required (long vowel + ř)

B1.question: bill / account
B1.explanation: 'účet' – ú at start + č (háček) are both needed

B1.question: to say / tell
B1.explanation: 'říkat' – ř with háček is essential for this verb

B1.question: too much
B1.explanation: 'příliš' – long í required in this adverb

B1.question: amazing
B1.explanation: 'úžasný' – ú at word start + ž are both required

B1.question: purpose
B1.explanation: 'účel' – ú at start + č with háček are required

B1.question: 'Daily' (adjective) is:
B1.explanation: 'denní' – doubled nn is correct in this adjective

B1.question: to reckon / count
B1.explanation: 'počítat' – č (háček) is required after po-

B1.question: to lead / guide (on foot)
B1.explanation: 'vést' = to lead/guide; 'vézt' = to transport by vehicle. They sound alike.

B1.question: 'Chicken' is correctly spelled:
B1.explanation: 'kuře' has ř (háček), not plain r.

B1.question: employer
B1.explanation: 'zaměstnavatel' = employer; 'zaměstnanec' = employee.

B1.question: 'Salt' is correctly spelled:
B1.explanation: 'sůl' has ů (kroužek); 'sul' is wrong.

B1.question: 'Pet' is correctly spelled:
B1.explanation: 'mazlíček' has č (háček) on the third syllable.

B1.question: 'Turtle' is correctly spelled:
B1.explanation: 'želva' begins with ž (háček), not plain z.

B1.question: 'Salad' is correctly spelled:
B1.explanation: 'salát' has a long á.

B1.question: A work trip is a ___ cesta:
B1.explanation: 'služební cesta' = business trip; 'služebná' = a maid.

B1.question: passport
B1.explanation: 'pas' (short a) = passport; 'pás' (long á) = belt.

B1.question: 'Mr.' (used before a name) is:
B1.explanation: 'pan' = Mr (with a name); 'pán' = gentleman / lord / master.

B1.question: to know (a fact)
B1.explanation: 'vědět' = to know (facts); 'vidět' = to see.

B1.question: 'Glad / gladly' (masc.) is:
B1.explanation: 'rád' = glad/gladly; 'řád' = order / rule (with ř).

B1.question: 'Whipped cream' is correctly spelled:
B1.explanation: 'šlehačka' begins with š (háček).

B1.question: 'Emperor' is correctly spelled:
B1.explanation: 'císař' has a long í and ř (háček).

B1.question: to transport (by vehicle)
B1.explanation: 'vézt' = to transport by vehicle; 'vést' = to lead/guide.

B1.question: 'Guinea pig' is correctly spelled:
B1.explanation: 'morče' has č (háček).

B2.question: 'Effective' (producing results) is:
B2.explanation: 'účinný' – doubled nn in the adjective suffix

B2.question: advantage
B2.explanation: 'výhoda' – prefix vý- always has a long vowel

B2.question: to confirm
B2.explanation: 'potvrdit' – no accent on r; Czech r is never accented

B2.question: to surpass
B2.explanation: 'předčit' – short i; no long vowel at the end

B2.question: 'Research' (výzkum) is:
B2.explanation: 'výzkum' – prefix vý- requires the long vowel

B2.question: survey / exploration
B2.explanation: 'průzkum' – prefix prů- always has ů (long u)

B2.question: cause / reason
B2.explanation: 'příčina' – long í in prefix pří- is required

B2.question: course / progress
B2.explanation: 'průběh' – prefix prů- always has the ů

B2.question: component / part
B2.explanation: 'součást' – č (háček) is required in this word

B2.question: favorable
B2.explanation: 'příznivý' – long í in prefix pří- is essential

B2.question: 'Obligation' (noun) is:
B2.explanation: 'povinnost' – doubled nn is the correct form

B2.question: discovery
B2.explanation: 'objev' – short e; no long vowel in this noun

B2.question: condition / requirement
B2.explanation: 'podmínka' – long í is required in this word

B2.question: situation
B2.explanation: 'situace' – no diacritics; borrowed word keeps simple vowels

C1.question: inadmissible
conditionality
to legalize
inevitable
immediate / direct
C1.explanation: 'bezprostřední' – short e, no long é here

C1.question: intermediary
to embezzle
presumed / assumed
indisputable
unconditional
disproportionate
C1.explanation: 'nepřiměřený' – ř in prefix při- is essential

C1.question: accountability
to destabilize
conscientiousness
